Game Overview

In Bridge Stick, the core idea is straightforward: stretch your precision to new heights in Bridge Stick. Tap and hold to extend your stick just right to cross endless challenging gaps. With simple visuals and addictive gameplay, see how many bridges you can conquer while aiming for that high score. Perfect for all skill levels!
